description:
Every property-level risk overlay in one call. Flat 30¢ — may grow
without increasing the bundle price as new overlays are added.

With ``?geojson=true`` each risk that has a polygon overlay also carries
its 1km-radius-clipped `geojson` FeatureCollection + `geojson_meta`.

**Price: 48¢ per call.**

geojson.description: When true, add a `geojson` FeatureCollection of the hazard polygons clipped to a 1km-radius circle around the property, plus `geojson_meta` (default false — response unchanged).
